id: title:jordanm-posthog:stop refetching the in app heatmap on window resize

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the heatmap visualization refresh mechanism in the frontend, replacing window-size subscriptions with a window resize event and an analysis-specific width subscription.
review.reason: The change replaces the previous window dimension subscriptions with a window resize event listener and an analysis-specific width subscription. This is a localized frontend behavior correction and capability update, not a systemic risk reduction or broad capability expansion. No score of 2 or 3 is supported.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and tests are not supplied, so the robustness and correctness of the replacement cannot be fully verified. The benefit is limited to the specific heatmap visualization context.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a window resize event listener and refetches heatmap data when window width changes; removes the windowWidth and windowHeight subscriptions and the setWindowWidthOverride action.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows heatmap requests to refresh when the browser window is resized, potentially updating the heatmap visualization without a page reload.

observations.behavior: Removes the windowWidth subscription and the setWindowWidthOverride action, replacing it with an analysisWidth subscription.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the trigger for heatmap refresh from window dimensions to an analysis-specific width, possibly supporting a different context or configuration.
